collection.title: KIA Sportage 2021 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A KIA Sportage 2021 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: KIA Sportage 2021 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
